text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale General holds 49 vials of filgrastim 480 mcg/1.6 mL, providing 17.1 days of supply at current daily use of 2.9 vials. FDA's drug shortage list does not include filgrastim as of this date.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include filgrastim as of 2026-10-21. FDA inspection records for Kashiv BioSciences, LLC (FEI 3011289655), a plant named on a label for a related product with operations including manufacture and analysis, show a VAI classification in 2015, an OAI classification in 2018, and a VAI classification on 2024-06-14.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 17 days. Five potential suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today. Sandoz Inc. and Tanvex BioPharma USA, Inc. are the first two ranked options with identifiable plants. Accord BioPharma Inc., Amgen, Inc., and Cipla USA Inc. are additional options, though their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Sandoz Inc. — requires approval by Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer to qualify Tanvex BioPharma USA, Inc. as a secondary source — requires approval by Pharmacy Director and P&T Committee.
3. Buyer to request plant information from Accord BioPharma Inc., Amgen, Inc., and Cipla USA Inc. — requires approval by Pharmacy Director.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose adjustments; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
